title: Dheeraj
desc: A gang of dacoits terrorises innocent people by stealing their belongings and killing them afterwards. In response, DSP Dheeraj is ordered to bring them to justice.

title: Obbalu Laila Goskara
desc: After returning from a world tour, a man comes across a woman and falls in love with her. However, she has no interest in him and rejects his proposal.

title: Venky Mama
desc: Venkatarathnam raises Karthik, his orphaned nephew, on his own after the death of his parents. Things change when Karthik suddenly leaves home without notice.

title: Masth Maja Madi
desc: Four unemployed friends hunt for buried treasure in Ooty's Botanical Gardens, unaware that a greedy police officer is hot on their heels, determined to seize the fortune for himself.

title: Eradu Nakshatragalu
desc: A chance encounter between a poor boy and a prince, who are strikingly similar in appearance, prompts them to exchange lives.
